update.title: Rebuilt the portfolio from independent page sections
update.summary: Split a 900-line homepage into independent section modules and shared style layers, then made section order and visibility configurable.

blocks.body:
## Compose the page from independent sections

I split the page into independent modules for the header, hero, featured work, roadmap, timeline, contact, and footer. Each section owns its HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, while shared layers handle design tokens, themes, backgrounds, base elements, and layout.

A site configuration controls which sections load and in what order. A small section loader reads that configuration and assembles the homepage.

blocks.caption: Section configuration, independent modules, and shared visual layers meet in the composed homepage.
blocks.code:
flowchart TD
  Config[Section order and visibility] --> Loader[Section loader]
  Header[Header module] --> Loader
  Hero[Hero module] --> Loader
  Work[Featured, roadmap, and timeline modules] --> Loader
  Contact[Contact and footer modules] --> Loader
  Styles[Shared tokens, themes, and layout] --> Loader
  Loader --> Page[Composed homepage]
